passage: Every few years, a new study claims that a single food can prevent disease, and the headlines follow. passage: Many people assume that the main obstacle to renewable energy is producing enough of it. Engineers increasingly argue that the harder problem is storage. Pumped storage, in which water is pushed uphill and later released through turbines, is cheaper over long periods, yet it is only possible where the landscape provides suitable hills and reservoirs.
